question: Find the area (in cm²) of a triangle whose length of each side is 7 cm, 24 cm and 0.25 m.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all sides to the same unit: 0.25 m = 25 cm.

The sides 7 cm, 24 cm, and 25 cm form a Pythagorean triplet (since 7² + 24² = 25²).

∴ The triangle is a right-angled triangle with base 24 cm and height 7 cm.

Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 24 × 7 = 84 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 84 cm².**
